stat.lineage_core.perk.strength.titan_gr: 1% chance on critical hit to execute targets up to 300 HP (bosses take 35% max HP).
stat.lineage_core.perk.strength.crushing: 10% chance on hit to inflict Slowness II for 2 seconds.
stat.lineage_core.perk.strength.heavy_li: +10% block breaking speed across all tools.
stat.lineage_core.perk.strength.limp_gri: Weak grip: block breaking speed is reduced by 15%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.strength.feeble_a: Muscle weakness: any heavy blow instantly disables your shield.
Muscular atrophy: melee damage dealt is reduced by 20%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.agility.shadow_st: +10% chance to completely dodge incoming attack damage.
stat.lineage_core.perk.agility.swift_str: +30% bow and crossbow draw speed, +10% attack speed.
stat.lineage_core.perk.agility.acrobatic: Fall damage is reduced by 20%, ladder climbing speed increased by 60%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.agility.clumsines: Fall damage is increased by 20%, ladder climbing speed reduced by 40%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.agility.sluggish_: Weapon attack cooldown after swings is increased by 25%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.agility.numb_step: Pain shock: taking any damage disables sprint for 2 seconds.
stat.lineage_core.perk.vitality.undying_: Cheats death with a totem resurrection effect once every 20 minutes.
stat.lineage_core.perk.vitality.iron_ski: +30% damage reduction against arrows, projectiles, fire, and explosions.
stat.lineage_core.perk.vitality.second_w: Natural health regeneration rate when saturated is increased by 50%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.vitality.short_wi: Natural health regeneration when saturated is 50% slower.
stat.lineage_core.perk.vitality.sickly_b: Periodic debuff damage (poison, wither, fire) is increased by 40%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.vitality.brittle_: Taking over 6 damage in a single hit inflicts Slowness for 3 seconds.
stat.lineage_core.perk.intelligence.arch: 15% chance to cast spells without consuming any mana.
stat.lineage_core.perk.intelligence.book: -25% experience levels cost when enchanting and using anvils.
stat.lineage_core.perk.intelligence.unle: Regular chat messages randomly scramble some letters.
stat.lineage_core.perk.intelligence.mudd: Spell casting mana cost is increased by 30%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.intelligence.amne: Arcane blockade: wielding a casting staff inflicts silence.
stat.lineage_core.perk.wisdom.enlightenm: Natural mana regeneration rate is permanently doubled (+100%).
stat.lineage_core.perk.wisdom.rune_maste: Using an anvil upgrades a random enchantment by +1 level beyond the limit.
stat.lineage_core.perk.wisdom.distracted: Enchantment descriptions on items are scrambled into alien runes.
stat.lineage_core.perk.wisdom.restless_s: Negative status effect durations are increased by 25%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.wisdom.spiritual_: Positive potion and blessing durations expire 50% faster.
stat.lineage_core.perk.charisma.village_: Successful trades with villagers yield double the items.
stat.lineage_core.perk.charisma.master_t: 20% chance to retain your emeralds and items when making trades.
stat.lineage_core.perk.charisma.diplomat: Permanent +20% discount on all villager trades.
stat.lineage_core.perk.charisma.ill_repu: Prices with villager traders are marked up by 20%.
stat.lineage_core.perk.charisma.antisoci: Repulsive aura: villagers refuse to trade with you in fear.
stat.lineage_core.perk.charisma.village_: Iron Golems see you as a hostile threat and attack on sight.
lineage.lineage_core.human.desc: Unremarkable and unbreakable. Learns fast and lands on its feet.
lineage.lineage_core.dwarf.desc: Short, sturdy, happiest below the sky with a pick in hand.
lineage.lineage_core.mermaid.desc: The sea carries its children and starves them ashore.
lineage.lineage_core.shadow.desc: A whisper given legs. Night is home; noon is a cage.
lineage.lineage_core.kobold.desc: Quick tunnel hands that shiver under open sun.
lineage.lineage_core.golem.desc: Walking masonry. No potion, no shove, no hurry.
lineage.lineage_core.vampire.desc: Pale nobility: strong at moonrise, ash by daylight, thirsty always.
lineage.lineage_core.felid.desc: Cat-footed and moon-eyed. Graceful everywhere but the river.
lineage.lineage_core.high_elf.desc: Tall scholars of the rod, clad in silk and starlight.
lineage.lineage_core.arch_lich.desc: Death, postponed indefinitely. Power with a phylactery's patience.
lineage.lineage_core.gambler.desc: Roll the bones: a borrowed past, a shuffled handful of gifts.
trait.lineage_core.old_blood.desc: Every fallen foe teaches you a little extra.
trait.lineage_core.fortune_favor.desc: Ore, crop and carcass yield a little more than they should.
trait.lineage_core.frail_blood.desc: Drawback: steel that pierces armor and open flame bite deeper.
trait.lineage_core.mountain_haste.desc: Your hands remember the deep mines: tireless digging.
trait.lineage_core.stone_limbs.desc: Drawback: water drags at mountain-born limbs.
trait.lineage_core.tidewise.desc: Clumsy ashore, graceful adrift; tireless delver of the drowned dark.
trait.lineage_core.shore_languor.desc: Drawback: dry land saps your strength.
trait.lineage_core.gloom_sight.desc: Darkness is merely dim to you.
trait.lineage_core.daylight_lassitude.de: Drawback: open sun weighs your limbs.
trait.lineage_core.hollow_belly.desc: Drawback: the gloom burns through your provisions.
trait.lineage_core.busy_claws.desc: Quick hands at the rock face.
trait.lineage_core.quarry_heart.desc: Potions slide off stone, boon and bane alike.
trait.lineage_core.moonlit_vigor.desc: Stronger and swifter while the moon reigns.
trait.lineage_core.red_thirst.desc: Your strikes drink a little back.
trait.lineage_core.pale_pyre.desc: Drawback: open daylight sets you alight.
trait.lineage_core.red_fare.desc: Only raw meat slakes you; lesser fare turns to ash.
trait.lineage_core.grave_scent.desc: Drawback: guardians and hounds bristle at your scent.
trait.lineage_core.lantern_eyes.desc: The night is an open book.
trait.lineage_core.river_dread.desc: Drawback: the river chills your courage.
trait.lineage_core.rod_oath.desc: Drawback: bare hands strike feebly without a staff.
trait.lineage_core.silk_vow.desc: Drawback: only soft hides may grace your shoulders.
trait.lineage_core.soul_jar.desc: Death is refused once each while, and you rise whole.
trait.lineage_core.wilt_aura.desc: Nearby monsters wither in your presence.
trait.lineage_core.graveward.desc: Venom, blight and hunger slide off dead flesh.
trait.lineage_core.ashen_pyre.desc: Drawback: the sun remembers you, and it hates you.
gui.lineage_core.oath_timeout: The oath went unanswered. Try again.
gui.lineage_core.fate_warn: The dice are cast and cannot be uncast.
gui.lineage_core.covenant_lore1: Blood remembers what the mind forgets.
gui.lineage_core.covenant_lore2: Choose once. Choose with both eyes open.
gui.lineage_core.marks_hint: [+] marks a gift of the blood. [-] marks its price.
gui.lineage_core.facet_detail: Sworn value %s, drift %s from the mortal ten.
message.lineage_core.ward_awakens: The soul jar shatters - and you stand.
